name: Enterprise Sourcing, Evaluation and Award
constraints: Supplier Bid profiles WM-ECO-021 and retains supplier-issued proposal identity and immutable submitted versions.
Bid Evaluation and Supplier Qualification are distinct WM-ACT-034 profiles with different subjects and validity.
Award Decision profiles WM-KNW-010 and references evaluation results without copying them.
Award, concluded agreement and purchase order remain separate acts and records.
Criteria changes create addenda and successor rounds with equal participant notification.
Conflicts, recusals, exclusions, waivers and superseded rounds remain append-only and explainable.
